data.case_title: Heat pump maintenance contract (Wärmepumpenservice Beispielelbe GmbH)
data.title: Maintenance contract for your heat pump - 14-day right of withdrawal
data.summary: Wärmepumpenservice Beispielelbe GmbH confirms the "Komfort" maintenance contract for the heat pump that was signed at the person's home on 20 November 2026, with a 12-month term starting 1 January 2027 at €19.90 per month, and informs about a 14-day right of withdrawal (Widerruf).
data.explanation: This letter confirms a maintenance service contract for your heat pump that you signed during a home visit on 20 November 2026, starting 1 January 2027 for 12 months at €19.90 per month. Because the contract was concluded at your home, you have a statutory right to withdraw (Widerruf) without giving a reason by sending a clear statement (letter or email) to the company. You may decide to keep the contract or withdraw from it, and the app shows until when you can still do so. If you do nothing, the contract remains valid and the monthly fee becomes payable from the start date.
data.tax_note: Costs for craftsman/maintenance services performed in a private household (Handwerkerleistungen) can be partly deductible under §35a EStG; keep this contract and any invoices for the tax return.

key_facts.label: Withdrawal period (Widerrufsfrist)
key_facts.quote: Sie können diesen Vertrag innerhalb von vierzehn Tagen ohne Begründung widerrufen.

items.title: Decide whether to withdraw from the maintenance contract (Widerruf)
items.action: If you no longer want this contract, send a clear withdrawal statement (by letter or email) to Wärmepumpenservice Beispielelbe GmbH before the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you don't withdraw in time, the contract stays in force and you must keep paying the monthly fee for the agreed term.
items.quote: Sie können diesen Vertrag innerhalb von vierzehn Tagen ohne Begründung widerrufen. Die Frist beginnt mit dem Tag, an dem der Vertrag geschlossen wurde.

items.title: Pay the monthly maintenance fee
items.action: Pay the €19.90 monthly fee for the heat pump maintenance contract once it starts.
